value.partitions_json: [{"name":"kinship_roles","fields":["cue","bearer","reference_person"],"prompt":"For every source relationship key, read only the literal supported kinship cue and its two directed roles. bearer is the person denoted by the cue; reference_person is the person whose relative the bearer is. Enumerate every source relationship with the same stable keys and source witnesses. Do not use payment roles, event names, dates, locations, residence, marriage, or the query. Return unread if direction or completeness is unresolved."},{"name":"kinship_period","fields":["start","end"],"prompt":"For every source relationship key, read only optional dates explicitly assigned to that kinship relationship. Work, payment, service, residence, marriage, birth, enrollment, location, and query dates do not qualify. Use null only when an exhaustive grammatical scan establishes that the corresponding relationship date is absent; leave expressly stated relationship dates available for literal copying. Enumerate exactly the same stable source keys and witnesses as the role relation, and return unread when attachment or completeness is ambiguous."}]
value.rationale: 保留一个含角色与可选亲属关系日期的完整耦合基线，并按实际错误依赖拆分为角色与期间两个共享键读取单元。约束程序只在窄而完整的语法扫描确认所有日期均附着于工作、服务、住所、婚姻或出生事件时，将亲属 start/end 限定为 null；明确给亲属关系定期或无法判定附着时返回 unread。它不生成事实、键、人物、日期或住所。
